_comment: Recorded from a real `docker buildx build --sbom=true --provenance=true
enhancedchannelmanager-3t0ht. Digests and sizes are elided; the SHAPE is
the load-bearing part and it is what scripts/candidate_image.py descends.
The finding this file exists to record: enabling `sbom:` does NOT add a
second unknown/unknown child. BuildKit emits ONE attestation manifest per
platform and puts the SPDX document and the SLSA provenance in it as two
in-toto layers. The index therefore has exactly two children with and
without `sbom:`, and the image manifest digest is byte-identical between
the two builds -- verified by building both and comparing.
archive of this shape and asserts the descent still resolves to the one
